propositions: Bare substring containment checks ('pandoc.org' in text, 'github.com/jgm/pandoc' in text) accept lookalike hostnames that do not actionably point to upstream (prefix-style notpandoc.org and suffix-style pandoc.org.evil.com).
GitHub code-scanning alert #88 (py/incomplete-url-substring-sanitization) flags the upstream-URL assertion in test_notice_names_pandoc_its_version_and_its_licence as incomplete sanitization.
A scheme+host-anchored regex with negative lookahead end-of-host boundaries rejects both lookalike classes while accepting valid NOTICE URLs.
The fix replaces bare substring checks with _UPSTREAM_RE compiled regex matching https?://(www\.)?pandoc\.org(?![\w.-]) and https?://github\.com/jgm/pandoc(?![\w-]) patterns.
The merged fix (Gerrit 1803, commit 588d7df0bd) cleared CodeQL alert #88 without dismissal after default-branch re-analysis.
Test file changes are isolated to the upstream-URL assertion; version pins and NOTICE content remain unchanged.
